test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Rescuers used a special device for finding people ______ in collapsed buildings.
solution:
The correct answer is **"trapped"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here we will the whole sentence:

__
 
• Rescuers used a special device for finding people** trapped** in collapsed buildings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here let's see the meaning of the given words:

 
• **Conquered -** to succeed in controlling or dealing with a strong feeling, problem, etc.
 
• **Trapped -** to catch and keep or store something
 
• **Exceeded -** to be more than a particular number or amount
 
• **Blossomed - **to become more healthy, confident or successful
